releases.notes:
## KTHREADD 4.1.0-beta.1 â€” Minecraft 1.20.4 / Fabric / Java 17

Comprehensive KTHREADD-only update. The previous release and the optional Creepy SalHack companion are preserved unchanged.

### Install and start

Download **`KTHREADD-1.20.4-4.1.0-beta.1.jar`** plus **`fabric-api-0.97.2+1.20.4.jar`**, or use **`KTHREADD-4.1.0-beta.1-Minecraft-1.20.4.zip`**. Close Minecraft, move the older KTHREADD JAR out of `mods`, and install the new JAR with one copy of Fabric API. Use Minecraft 1.20.4, Java 17 and Fabric Loader 0.15.11+ (tested on 0.19.5).

**Delete** opens the menu; right-click expands settings; **Ctrl+F** searches modules and settings. `/kthread preset balanced` applies a starting configuration without changing module toggles. Then enable CrystalAura, AutoTotem, AutoArmor and AntiFriendHit as desired. `aggressive` and `defensive` presets also retain self/friend protections. `/kthread combatreport` exports local fight diagnostics.

### Improvements

- **Crystal combat:** bounded expensive work, retry backoff and observed confirmation timing, multi-sample motion forecasting, latency-adjusted conservative prediction, stable pressure focus, damage-trade filtering and bounded near-first break ranking.
- **Survival and inventory:** two-hit threat assessment, missing-item fallback, durability-aware armor, suitable/Efficiency-aware tools, stack-aware looting, and normal sneaking placement on container supports.
- **Melee and protection:** weapon/cooldown ownership, stronger critical guards, configurable full-charge bow release and renewed/cleaned-up AntiChainPop ownership. AutoLog runs independently of offensive action ownership.
- **Movement:** deterministic velocity priority, environmental guards, proper input restoration, configurable respawn/void rescue, particle-distance budgeting and separate velocity/explosion controls.
- **Rendering and usability:** incremental bounded storage scans, friend/invisibility filters and entity caps, richer combat HUD, settings search, improved profile navigation and atomic backup recovery. Through-wall/no-bob rendering remains intact.

All **54 registered entries** were inspected. **Seven already-correct hooks were retained** rather than given cosmetic changes; the included module audit distinguishes those cases.

### Verification

- **57 unit tests** and **61 targeted local game checks** passed.
- **28 combined production rendering/compatibility checks** passed with unchanged SalHack on Fabric Loader 0.19.5.
- Actual game checks cover chest-supported placement without opening its inventory, slot/sneak restoration, configured bow charge with a real server projectile, AntiChainPop ownership/cleanup, actual crystal placement/breaking/spawn reactions, emergency offhand retention, report export, and a 64-crystal fixture bounded to 32 evaluations.
- All **109 release class files** match the standalone public-source build. This is the exact production-tested JAR.
- SHA-256: `9566befbc6406f89301078fd83308c48b59abacf374817a5cb29432f6c9a14ab`.

See `VERIFICATION.json`, `SHA256SUMS.txt`, the source archive and the [module audit](https://github.com/bengonzalesdr/KTHREADD/blob/main/docs/MODULE-AUDIT-4.1.md). GitHub Actions also builds and tests the public source.

### Limits

This is a development beta. Local tests do not establish every mode, server/modpack/shader combination, anti-cheat acceptance or competitive win rate. No AI component was added. Storage refresh is incremental; threat handling is deliberately conservative. No personal worlds, credentials, raw machine logs or legacy IngrosWare binary/decompiled implementation are published.

## KTHREADD Fabric 1.20.4

**Minecraft 1.20.4 Â· Fabric Â· Java 17** â€” development release.

### Install

Download **`KTHREADD-1.20.4-4.0-port.6-render.jar`** plus **`fabric-api-0.97.2+1.20.4.jar`**, and put them in your Fabric 1.20.4 instance's `mods` folder. Move previous versions of this client out first. The combined **`Minecraft-1.20.4-Clients-Rendering-Update.zip`** contains both clients and one copy of Fabric API, with installation notes.

**Menus:** KTHREADD **Delete**; Creepy SalHack **Left Arrow**. Right-click a module to expand settings. Source ZIPs are for developers and do not go in `mods`.

### Included update

- Storage ESP and Entity ESP visible through opaque blocks by default.
- Thin, configurable tracers, view-bob compensation and interpolated entity positions.
- Camera-relative rendering to reduce precision jitter at large coordinates.
- Duplicate ESP/tracer ownership coordinated when both clients run together.
- SalHack shulker preview keeps the contents grid and removes the redundant text list.
- KTHREADD retains ranked crystal combat, guarded spawn reactions, pending-damage reservations and local fight reports (`/kthread combatreport`).

### Verification

This client's binary passed **32 unit tests**, **50 targeted local game checks**, and **28 combined rendering/compatibility checks** with the companion client. The independently buildable public source was rebuilt; all release class files matched byte-for-byte. The released JAR is the exact binary used in the game checks. Fabric Loader 0.19.5 was used for combined production tests.

SHA-256 (`KTHREADD-1.20.4-4.0-port.6-render.jar`): `31793bf49ac0140e5bcccfd9f146b487abd6fd519503f45cbadd449d46e6310a`.

Checksums for all assets are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Complete historical feature parity, every shader/modpack, remote-server performance and competitive win rate are not verified.

KTHREADD is independently authored and MIT licensed. Original IngrosWare code, assets, binary and decompiled source are not redistributed.

Source and install documentation are in this repository. Please report reproducible bugs with exact versions, settings and sanitized logs.
